errors.denied: The PC denied access. Check pairing and the separate PC backup-folder approval.
errors.invalid_request: The PC rejected this request. Pending work is retained.
errors.not_found: The PC operation was not found. It will not be silently replaced.
errors.conflict: The PC operation does not match this source or offset. Automatic resume is blocked.
errors.hash_mismatch: The verified bytes did not match. Completion was not accepted.
errors.acl_busy: The PC authorization journal is busy. Retry later.
errors.acl_unavailable: PC authorization cannot be verified. File access stays closed.
errors.backup_unavailable: The PC backup folder is unavailable. Reconnect it and retry.
errors.backup_full: PC backup storage is full. Free space on the PC and retry.
errors.backup_busy: The PC backup file is locked. Close the locking application and retry.
errors.backup_permission_denied: The PC cannot access the approved backup folder. Check its permissions.
errors.backup_path_rejected: The PC rejected an unsafe backup path.

errors.identity_unavailable: Native device identity is unavailable. File access stays closed.

errors.outcome_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Pending work is retained; no success is assumed.
errors.owner_deleted: This source version was deleted on the computer. It will not be automatically uploaded again.
errors.source_identity_unknown: Retained source identities are ambiguous. Review is required; no automatic upload.
errors.retry_clock_unavailable: A reliable retry interval cannot be verified. Work is retained; automatic retry stopped.
errors.storage_failure: The durable record could not be read or saved. The pause or continue result is unconfirmed; check again.
errors.automatic_unavailable: The operating system could not schedule automatic backup. Automatic execution is not confirmed; you can start a manual backup with Sync now.
errors.settings_changed: Stopped because settings changed. Completed backups and recovery records are retained. New work uses the current sources, PC and schedule settings.
errors.source_unavailable: Make the source available in Files or select it again; pending work is retained.
errors.local_permission_lost: Kloda cannot access a local file or folder on this phone. Check its Files permission.
errors.local_path_rejected: A local path or file could not be verified safely. Nothing was overwritten.
errors.interrupted: The app stopped before the result was confirmed. Progress is retained for verified resume.
errors.photos_unavailable: iOS Photos backup is not connected yet. Files results are shown separately.
errors.review_required: Photos import needs review. No automatic second copy will be created.

pairing.title: Pair your phone
pairing.description: Scan the Kloda invitation on your computer. Both devices must be on the same local network.
pairing.scanDescription: Point the rear camera at the computer's Kloda QR code. No manual secret entry is available.
pairing.cameraPermission: Camera access is used only to scan this pairing invitation.
pairing.cameraDenied: Camera permission is denied. Allow access to scan; pairing cannot proceed without a QR scan.
pairing.cameraError: Camera permission could not be checked or requested.
pairing.cameraUnavailable: The rear camera could not be opened. It may be unavailable or in use by another app.
pairing.cameraPaused: The camera is paused while Kloda is in the background.
pairing.noFileGrant: Pairing establishes device trust only. It does not grant access to files, folders or photos.
pairing.cancelConsequences: Cancellation affects this phone's attempt or local binding only. The computer may retain a committed record; this is not distributed rollback.
pairing.unknownDescription: An interrupted operation is not proof of success or rollback. Read native status, or explicitly resume or cancel a saved attempt.
pairing.leaveConsequences: Leaving closes this view and its connection. It does not complete pairing or delete saved pending or pinned records.
pairing.repairDescription: This computer's previous local trust was revoked. Check the authenticated computer fingerprint before explicitly pairing again.
pairing.repairConsequences: The old revoked record and all file-access denies remain unchanged. A new attempt still requires approval on the computer.
pairing.helpComputer: Open the phone-pairing invitation in Kloda on your computer. After scanning, approve the exact phone candidate there.
pairing.helpLan: Keep both devices on the same local network. Pairing does not use a remote relay or accept a manually entered secret.
pairing.helpRecovery: A saved pending record is not a completed pairing. Resume retries the same native-owned identity binding; cancellation does not delete the computer's record.

unpair.title: Remove pairing with this computer?
unpair.description: When reachable, the PC must confirm durable revocation first. Phone-only removal does not revoke the PC’s permissions. Backed-up photos are not deleted.
unpair.pc_confirmed: The PC durably revoked device trust and file permissions. Pairing was removed on this phone; backed-up photos were preserved.
unpair.local_only: Pairing was removed only on this phone. PC revocation was not confirmed; its old permissions may remain. A new QR pairing is required to reconnect.
unpair.pc_unconfirmed: The PC did not confirm durable revocation. Pairing has not been removed on this phone. Retry, or explicitly remove only on this phone.

computer.title: Back up to your computer
computer.description: Send selected files and photos to your own computer over your local network.
computer.pairDescription: Open Kloda on your computer and scan its pairing QR with this phone.
computer.grantTitle: 2. Approve the backup folder on the computer
computer.grantDescription: In Devices and permissions on the computer, select this phone. Choose a separate backup folder and explicitly approve file access. This permission cannot be granted from the phone.
computer.availability: Pairing does not confirm that the computer is currently reachable or its receiver is ready. Keep the computer awake with Kloda running. Backup Activity shows current access and transfer results.
computer.iosBackground: iOS may run authorized backups when it provides an execution opportunity. Locked protected data may defer work. New pairing, approvals and restore require the app in the foreground.
computer.iosSchedulePreference: iOS chooses when automatic work can run; exact timing or continuous execution is not guaranteed. Pause stops automatic backups until Continue is selected.
computer.androidBackground: Authorized backups continue when you leave this screen while Android permits. New pairing, approvals and restore require the app in the foreground. If the system stops the work, reopen the app to continue.
computer.foregroundOnly: Keep the app in the foreground for pairing, approval and restore. Native transfer and background integration are not complete on this platform yet.
computer.inactive: Bring Kloda to the foreground to read current status.
computer.androidSchedulePreference: Android runs automatic work when the OS allows; exact timing or continuous execution is not guaranteed. Pause also stops automatic backups until Continue is selected.
computer.schedulePreference: The schedule preference is saved; automatic execution is not enabled on this platform yet.

hub.title: Kloda design prototype
hub.subtitle: From your phone to your computer and the storage you choose — private, local-first backup.
gapsList: Cloud provider sign-in methods (OAuth/password) are not final — marked as integration points in forms.
The real QR pairing protocol and device trust key format need to be defined.
Window behavior on Linux desktops without a tray awaits a product decision.
Naming rule for 'keep both copies' in conflict resolution must be defined.
End-to-end encryption, remote access and Wake-on-LAN are out of scope and not promised.

setup.m1Body: Kloda backs up your files and photos to your own computer or the storage you choose. No central account required.
m1Points: You pick source folders and albums
You pair with your computer via QR
You grant the backup folder separately on the computer
